Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with a normal MCV and MCH, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Erythrocyte count is slightly elevated, possibly reflecting compensation or lab artifact. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is markedly increased, indicating significant variation in platelet size, which may suggest reactive changes. Further clinical correlation and investigation of anemia etiology are recommended.
